title: Auto-capture git evidence at agent finish
description: Context: a 2h47m dabble-employee-app agent session made 300 CLI calls with 24 failures. Failure clusters: 117 read-only work show polls (~40% of all calls), 14 identical failed sync refresh retries, 6 vault init retries, 66 agent finish calls with only 2 standalone evidence records, 6 NOT_FOUND finish/release (ownership confusion), 1 CONFLICT claim, 2 POLICY_VIOLATION sprint closes. Design principle for this mission: every response (success or error) must carry enough state that the correct next action is derivable without another read, and the honest path (evidence, ownership, health) must be the path of least resistance. Problem: 66 finishes produced 2 standalone evidence records; closed does not mean verified. Change: when agent finish runs inside a git repo, automatically capture HEAD SHA, current branch, and dirty status from the execution root and attach it as a command/diff evidence record on the work item, without requiring the agent to do anything. Where: finish handler in apps/cli/src/commands.ts plus evidence creation via the existing evidence machinery; git probing likely already exists for the git health checks (docs/architecture/GIT_HEALTH_HARDENING.md describes current git awareness). Constraint: must degrade gracefully outside a git repo (skip with a note, not an error); must record the execution root path so lane-isolation work can later distinguish lane worktrees; do not block finish if git probing fails, just annotate.
acceptanceCriteria: agent finish in a git repo attaches an evidence record with HEAD SHA, branch, and dirty status automatically
Finish outside a git repo succeeds with an explicit no-git note instead of evidence
Git probe failure annotates the finish but never blocks it
